summary: Operator page (TRL RV Resort): $45/night for 2, $270/wk, monthly $450-1,050, seasonal $2,490-6,250, +$5 extra guest/pet; full hookups at all but a handful of sites; phone booking only (stored 'reservable online' was wrong). flags: Waterfront: stored 'not waterfront' CONFIRMED by measurement. The RV loops sit on a hilltop off Kimberling Blvd; the operator's launch ramp/dock is at the head of a cove reached by a gravel lane, ~300-350 m from the nearest pads, with woods between. The old note's 'lake-path sites' appears nowhere on the operator's page (dropped). The ramp and dock are not evidence.
Price gate: $45/night for 2 people (+$5 extra guest or pet). Branson gateway 18 km. Presence: operator website with phone (417) 739-4627; Google 4.3 over 53 reviews.

LONG-STAY (report; passes on what is readable, occupancy UNREAD): the operator markets 'Nightly, weekly, monthly, and seasonal' sites and 'Localize your Glamper', with seasonal rates to $6,250; imagery shows ~110 tightly packed rigs, many with decks/sheds. Five tests: (1) $45 passes; (2) nightly rate posted, booking by phone with no application - passes; (3) no minimum stated - passes; (4) 1 in 10 nightly - CANNOT be checked, there is no booking engine and the operator says only 'we'll typically have something available'; (5) RV park, not a home community - passes. AWH may want a phone check.

RV Life record 258699's three reviews (sites 247, 250, 52; 'Campground 2', 'Table Rock State Park') describe Table Rock State Park, not this park - the stored rating (rvlife 4*, $$) likely comes from a mis-merged record.

Google lists the website as tablerockcamping.com, which serves the same page as the stored trlresort.com; the stored website is fine. Google name: 'Table Rock Lake RV Resort & Marina'; the operator page brands itself 'TRL RV Resort'.
